Tool access is limited, so I'm checking the sealed validation matrix entry and then writing up the conclusion.

I recommend **approving** this change, with five low-severity follow-ups and no blockers.

I could only run part of what the brief asks for. Of the tools, `pose artifact-check --strict` and `pose surface-check --strict` ran. Running `go test`, `pose validate` and `pose assess design` was denied. So test results come from the sealed evidence plus my own reading of the code. The two `validate` tools are marked `passed` on that sealed build, unit and integration evidence, not on a run of mine.

- **artifact-check** reported no errors. Its 918 findings are all repo-wide "orphan" warnings that this change didn't introduce. It examined a later head, `af2af0ef`, which only adds governance and index files after `f76a4b1c`.
- **surface-check** reported `surface.findings=0`.

**Requirements:**
- **R1 (one POSIX `sh -c` word):** `pickerPreviewCommand` (`pose-mcp/internal/cli/delegate_watch.go:226-237`) returns `sh -c '<fixed script>' '<pose path>' {1}`. The script contains only `"$0"`, `"$1"`, the line count and the refresh interval: no quote, backslash or path. So nothing outside the quotes is shell syntax, and it parses in fish, zsh and bash.
- **R2 (columns, glyph, hidden id):** `pickerLines`, `pickerStateWidth` and `padCells` lead each row with the id and pad the state column by code points. `--with-nth 2..` hides the id, and the header uses the same widths. Round-1 F1 (the misaligned state column) and F2 (the untested rows and arguments) are fixed.
- **R3 (list on top, with a border):** `pickerArgs` passes `--layout reverse` and `--border`.
- **Compatibility:** `--refresh 0` and the numbered menu still work. The menu's columns are reordered, which is cosmetic.

**Sweep:** `delegate_watch.go` is the only place in `internal/cli` that builds a shell string. Every other `exec.Command` call passes its arguments directly, with no shell.

**Findings (all low, all follow-ups):**
- **F3** (carried, `delegate_watch.go:256`): `shellQuote` doesn't protect a pose path containing a backslash under fish, because fish still processes `\\` and `\'` inside single quotes.
- **F4** (carried, `delegate_watch_picker_test.go:35`): the fish parse check is skipped when fish isn't installed, so CI may never run it.
- **G1** (`delegate_watch.go:200` and `:221`): the agent column is a fixed 18 characters. An agent name longer than that pushes the age column out of line, against R2's "aligned columns". Agent names come from user-defined policy keys.
- **G2** (`.pose/indexes/validation-matrix.json:2622`): the targeted `delegate-picker-integration` check doesn't run `TestThePickerRowsAlignEveryStateAndTheArgumentsHideTheID`. R2 and R3 cite that test, but only the full unit run covers it.
- **G3** (`delegate_watch.go:237`): fzf replaces placeholders such as `{}`, `{q}` and `{1}` anywhere in the preview command, including inside the quoted pose path. A path containing one of them would get the selection substituted into it. This is the "path interpolated into a script" class the sweep was asked to look for.

**Assumption:** the round-1 findings aren't recorded in the repository. I mapped F3 and F4 to the follow-up the spec records (the fish backslash quoting and the skipped fish check). F1 and F2 are described as fixed in the implementer's notes, and I confirmed both in the code.

I recommend **approving** this change, with five low-severity follow-ups and no blockers.

I could only run part of what the brief asks for. Of the tools, `pose artifact-check --strict` and `pose surface-check --strict` ran. Running `go test`, `pose validate` and `pose assess design` was denied. So test results come from the sealed evidence plus my own reading of the code. The two `validate` tools are marked `passed` on that sealed build, unit and integration evidence, not on a run of mine.

- **artifact-check** reported no errors. Its 918 findings are all repo-wide "orphan" warnings that this change didn't introduce. It examined a later head, `af2af0ef`, which only adds governance and index files after `f76a4b1c`.
- **surface-check** reported `surface.findings=0`.

**Requirements:**
- **R1 (one POSIX `sh -c` word):** `pickerPreviewCommand` (`pose-mcp/internal/cli/delegate_watch.go:226-237`) returns `sh -c '<fixed script>' '<pose path>' {1}`. The script contains only `"$0"`, `"$1"`, the line count and the refresh interval: no quote, backslash or path. So nothing outside the quotes is shell syntax, and it parses in fish, zsh and bash.
- **R2 (columns, glyph, hidden id):** `pickerLines`, `pickerStateWidth` and `padCells` lead each row with the id and pad the state column by code points. `--with-nth 2..` hides the id, and the header uses the same widths. Round-1 F1 (the misaligned state column) and F2 (the untested rows and arguments) are fixed.
- **R3 (list on top, with a border):** `pickerArgs` passes `--layout reverse` and `--border`.
- **Compatibility:** `--refresh 0` and the numbered menu still work. The menu's columns are reordered, which is cosmetic.

**Sweep:** `delegate_watch.go` is the only place in `internal/cli` that builds a shell string. Every other `exec.Command` call passes its arguments directly, with no shell.

**Findings (all low, all follow-ups):**
- **F3** (carried, `delegate_watch.go:256`): `shellQuote` doesn't protect a pose path containing a backslash under fish, because fish still processes `\\` and `\'` inside single quotes.
- **F4** (carried, `delegate_watch_picker_test.go:35`): the fish parse check is skipped when fish isn't installed, so CI may never run it.
- **G1** (`delegate_watch.go:200` and `:221`): the agent column is a fixed 18 characters. An agent name longer than that pushes the age column out of line, against R2's "aligned columns". Agent names come from user-defined policy keys.
- **G2** (`.pose/indexes/validation-matrix.json:2622`): the targeted `delegate-picker-integration` check doesn't run `TestThePickerRowsAlignEveryStateAndTheArgumentsHideTheID`. R2 and R3 cite that test, but only the full unit run covers it.
- **G3** (`delegate_watch.go:237`): fzf replaces placeholders such as `{}`, `{q}` and `{1}` anywhere in the preview command, including inside the quoted pose path. A path containing one of them would get the selection substituted into it. This is the "path interpolated into a script" class the sweep was asked to look for.
